name: figma-cli
tagline: Describe what you want; it gets built live in Figma Desktop.

page.objective: Let an assistant build directly in Figma Desktop while you talk to it in ordinary language.
page.problem: Figma automation normally needs an API key, a paid plan and a plugin to babysit.
page.solution: A local daemon talks to a companion plugin, so no subscription or API key is involved.
